_doc: The few tileMapAnalyzer category flags that no measurement in id-table.json gives, keyed on the table's own per-id 'kind' vocabulary. Everything else a category carries -- its name, its members, its 'solid' and its colour -- is DERIVED (see kittygif/viewer.py). Nineteen rows stand in for a hundred and thirty ids; that is the whole point of keying on the kind.

_consumers.lethal: tileCategorizer.deriveFloorFlags + reachabilityAnalyzer.isBlockingTile -- cannot be stood on, kills on contact
_consumers.blocks_floor: same two -- cannot be stood on, but a jump arc passes through (an enemy)
_consumers.is_region: reachabilityAnalyzer.findPointsOfInterest -- a place the rules graph names
_consumers.is_location: the same, and an Archipelago check sits here
